summary.what_it_does: This page is the index of Adept's blog, listing posts from April 2022 to August 2024. Posts cover the Adept Workflow Language (AWL) for composing multimodal web interactions on Adept's models, and the Fuyu-Heavy multimodal model built for digital agents. It also lists open-source releases: Fuyu-8B (a small multimodal model) and Persimmon-8B (a language model under 10 billion parameters with a permissive license). Other entries include ACT-1, a transformer for actions, company news such as a $350M Series B and SOC 2 Type 1 compliance, and technical write-ups on training-run errors and FlashAttention. The page itself is only a list of titles and short excerpts; the full posts are not included here.
notable: Adept Workflow Language (AWL) for composing multimodal web interactions
